subject: Request: Privilege origin snapshot + SAML session assertions for SOC 2 / SIG

From: Maya Rivas <maya.rivas@wellpath.com>

Cc: Security Ops <sec-ops@wellpath.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2/SIG - Privilege origin snapshot & session assertions

Hi Tessa,

Hope you're well. As part of our SOC 2 readiness and to complete the SIG intake, we need two pieces of evidence from Redwood: a privilege-origin snapshot (who granted elevated roles, with timestamps) covering the last 90 days, and a sample of SAML session assertions for admin-level accounts (we typically ask for ~10 unique admin sessions).

Deliverable expectations:
- Privilege-origin snapshot: CSV/JSON export showing account, role change event, actor, timestamp, and justification/owner field if available.
- SAML session assertions: raw assertion (redacted) plus one-line mapping to a user identifier; if redaction is necessary please follow your standard process and indicate what was removed.

Can we get a proposed ETA and a preferred format? Also attaching the current SIG spreadsheet for fields we reference.

Thanks,
Maya R.
Security Program Manager
WellPath Health

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Vanessa (provisioning exports), Marcus (session logs), and Irene (PII/redaction) to own pieces. Proposed plan below: 

What we'll deliver by 2027-04-26 EOD (tentative):
- Privilege origin snapshot (CSV): role_change_id, user_email_hash, prior_role, new_role, actor_email, event_ts_utc, owner_field (if present). See attached SCIM sample we plan to align to.
- SAML session assertions: 10 redacted assertion files (one per folder) plus a mapping CSV that ties each sample to a Berkeley-style user id (non-PII).
- Short delivery note describing redaction steps and hashes used for mapping.

Action owners: 
- vanessa_ortiz: export SCIM delta & role-change events (range: 2027-01-22 -> 2027-04-22).
- marcus_lin: pull auth service session assertions and scrub keys.
- irene_choi: apply redaction guidance and produce the delivery note.

I've attached a workback plan and our redaction guidelines for visibility. If that ETA works for you we'll begin prep and share a Drive folder link.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Tessa / team — this plan looks great, thank you. Two quick follow-ups before you upload: 
1) For the privilege-origin snapshot, can you include the policy id (if available) that triggered the role assignment, or the API request id that recorded the change? That helps our SIG mapping.
2) For the SAML assertions, please also note the assertion signature algorithm and whether the assertion included an attributes block (we typically document attribute-level exposure).

If you can drop the Drive link into HubSpot case HS-12345 we'll route this to our auditors and confirm receipt.

Appreciate it — Maya
